tool_schemas.name: list_dashboards
tool_schemas.description: Lists dashboards from the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation, optionally filtered by collection, status/archived flag, and sorted; returns up to `limit` items and a `cursor` to fetch the next page when more results remain. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/pagination input is invalid (including malformed IDs, out-of-range `limit`, or an unusable `cursor`), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to browse dashboards or the requested collection. Raises NOT_FOUND when `collection_id` refers to no known collection in the local representation, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request-rate or execution quotas for listing are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Filter dashboards to a specific local Metabase collection id.

limit.description: Maximum number of dashboards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_cards
tool_schemas.description: Lists questions/cards from the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation, optionally filtered by collection, database, status/archived flag, and display type, and returns results sorted with cursor-based pagination (`limit` plus `cursor` for the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid filter values, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid/expired `cursor`, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you do not have permission to browse cards or the referenced parent resources. Raises NOT_FOUND if `collection_id` or `database_id` does not exist in the local representation, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing limits are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Filter cards to a specific local Metabase collection id.

database_id.description: Filter cards to a specific local Metabase database id.

display.description: Filter by card display type (e.g., table, bar, line).

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists Metabase databases known to the Integration Server, optionally filtered by status and engine, returning up to `limit` items per page with an opaque `cursor` for pagination and optional sorting by the supported fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort values, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid `cursor`, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to browse database metadata. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when list-rate limits are exceeded.

engine.description: Filter by database engine (e.g., postgres, mysql).

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: execute_card
tool_schemas.description: Executes the specified card/question through the Integration Server, applying `parameters_json` and returning the card’s execution output in the requested `result_format` along with an execution/audit-log entry reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is malformed, parameters are not acceptable for the card, or `result_format` is unsupported, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to run the card or access its underlying data. Raises NOT_FOUND if `card_id` does not exist in the local representation, CONFLICT if the card is not in an executable state (for example archived/deleted), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when query execution limits are exceeded.

card_id.description: Local Metabase card id to execute.

parameters_json.description: Parameter values to apply when executing the card.

result_format.description: Desired result format identifier for the execution output.

tool_schemas.name: get_dashboard_cards
tool_schemas.description: Returns the dashboard-card links (cards placed on a dashboard), optionally filtered by link status, sorted as requested, and paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed `dashboard_id`, invalid sort/order values, out-of-range `limit`, or an invalid `cursor`, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot view the dashboard or its cards. Raises NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist in the local representation, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when listing limits are exceeded.

dashboard_id.description: Local Metabase dashboard id whose cards should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of dashboard cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort.description: Field to sort dashboard cards by.

tool_schemas.name: execute_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL text against the specified Metabase database via the Integration Server, applies optional `parameters_json`, and returns the execution output in the requested `result_format` along with an execution/audit-log entry reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `database_id` is malformed, `sql_text` is empty/invalid, parameters are invalid for the execution, or `result_format` is unsupported, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to run SQL against the database. Raises NOT_FOUND if `database_id` does not exist in the local representation, CONFLICT if the database is not in an executable state (for example deleted), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when query execution limits are exceeded.

database_id.description: Local Metabase database id to run the SQL against.

parameters_json.description: Optional parameter values used by the query execution.

result_format.description: Desired result format identifier for the execution output.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def execute_query(database_id, sql_text, parameters_json=None, result_format=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0534000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0534000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    req_file = "request_logs.json"
    reqs = _load(req_file)

    def _log(status_code, credential_id=None, details=None):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + hashlib.sha256((now + "|" + str(len(reqs) + 1)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22].upper(),
            "endpoint": "execute_query",
            "credential_id": credential_id,
            "status": status_code,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": now
        }
        if details is not None:
            row["details"] = details
        reqs.append(row)
        _save(req_file, reqs)

    def _enforce_limits():
        limits = _load("rate_limits.json")
        if not isinstance(limits, list):
            return None
        for lim in limits:
            if not isinstance(lim, dict):
                continue
            if lim.get("enabled") is False:
                continue
            scope = lim.get("scope", "global")
            if scope not in ("global", "all"):
                continue
            rpm = lim.get("requests_per_minute")
            if isinstance(rpm, int) and rpm > 0:
                cutoff = (datetime.datetime.utcnow() - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
                recent = [r for r in reqs if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("timestamp", "") >= cutoff]
                if len(recent) >= rpm:
                    return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded.")
            qpd = lim.get("requests_per_day")
            if isinstance(qpd, int) and qpd > 0:
                day = datetime.datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat()
                today = [r for r in reqs if isinstance(r, dict) and str(r.get("timestamp", "")).startswith(day)]
                if len(today) >= qpd:
                    return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily quota exceeded.")
        return None

    lim_err = _enforce_limits()
    if lim_err:
        _log(lim_err["error"]["code"])
        return lim_err

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(database_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mbdb_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", database_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed database_id.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if not isinstance(sql_text, str) or sql_text.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sql_text must be a non-empty string.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if parameters_json is not None and not isinstance(parameters_json, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parameters_json must be an object.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if result_format is not None and not isinstance(result_format, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "result_format must be a string.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    dbs = _load("metabase_databases_schema.json")
    db = next((d for d in dbs if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("id") == database_id), None)
    if not db or db.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Database not found or not active.")
        _log("NOT_FOUND")
        return e

    metabase_database_id = db.get("metabase_database_id")
    if not isinstance(metabase_database_id, int):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Database mirror missing metabase_database_id.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    executions_file = "metabase_executions.json"
    executions = _load(executions_file)

    def _new_exec_id():
        seed = f"{now}|query|{database_id}|{len(executions)+1}"
        return "mbe_" + hashlib.sha256(seed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22].upper()

    exec_id = _new_exec_id()

    # Create execution in queued
    exec_row = {
        "id": exec_id,
        "execution_type": "query",
        "card_id": None,
        "metabase_card_id": None,
        "database_id": database_id,
        "metabase_database_id": metabase_database_id,
        "sql_text": sql_text,
        "parameters_json": parameters_json,
        "result_format": result_format,
        "result_metadata_json": None,
        "row_count": None,
        "runtime_ms": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "error_message": None,
        "error_details_json": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }
    executions.append(exec_row)
    _save(executions_file, executions)

    # Transition queued -> running
    exec_row["status"] = "running"
    exec_row["started_at"] = now
    exec_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save(executions_file, executions)

    # Offline "execution": do not actually run SQL; simulate deterministic success unless configured to fail
    # Optional redaction config
    cfg = _load("integration_config.json")
    redact = False
    if isinstance(cfg, dict):
        redact = bool(cfg.get("redact_sql_text", False))
    if redact:
        exec_row["sql_text"] = "[REDACTED]"
        _save(executions_file, executions)

    # Simulate output
    # If sql contains a clear error marker, fail deterministically
    sql_lower = sql_text.lower()
    failed = ("-- fail" in sql_lower) or ("/* fail */" in sql_lower) or ("raise_error" in sql_lower)

    finished_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    runtime_ms = max(0, int((finished_dt - now_dt).total_seconds() * 1000))

    if failed:
        # running -> failed (legal)
        exec_row["status"] = "failed"
        exec_row["error_message"] = "Query execution failed."
        exec_row["error_details_json"] = {"reason": "Simulated failure (offline execution)."}
        exec_row["runtime_ms"] = runtime_ms
        exec_row["finished_at"] = finished_dt.isoformat() + "Z"
        exec_row["updated_at"] = exec_row["finished_at"]
        _save(executions_file, executions)
        resp = {
            "execution": exec_row,
            "result": None
        }
        _log("OK", details={"terminal_status": "failed"})
        return resp

    # running -> succeeded (legal)
    exec_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    exec_row["runtime_ms"] = runtime_ms
    exec_row["finished_at"] = finished_dt.isoformat() + "Z"
    exec_row["updated_at"] = exec_row["finished_at"]

    # Provide lightweight, deterministic "result"
    # Return format: json default
    fmt = (result_format or "json").lower()
    exec_row["result_metadata_json"] = {
        "format": fmt,
        "offline": True,
        "metabase_database_id": metabase_database_id
    }

    # Minimal dummy rows; row_count set
    dummy_rows = [{"ok": True, "database": db.get("name"), "metabase_database_id": metabase_database_id}]
    exec_row["row_count"] = len(dummy_rows)
    _save(executions_file, executions)

    if fmt == "csv":
        # simple CSV string
        result = "ok,database,metabase_database_id\ntrue,{},{:d}\n".format(
            (db.get("name") or "").replace(",", " "),
            metabase_database_id
        )
    else:
        result = {"rows": dummy_rows}

    resp = {
        "execution": exec_row,
        "result": result
    }
    _log("OK", details={"terminal_status": "succeeded"})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: create_card
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new card/question in the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation with the provided name, database association, dataset_query, and display settings, returning the created card record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs are malformed, `dataset_query_json` is not valid for the selected database, or `display` is unsupported, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create cards in the target collection or database. Raises NOT_FOUND if `collection_id` (when provided) or `database_id` does not exist in the local representation, and CONFLICT if the request attempts to create a card in an invalid state (for example creating directly as deleted) or violates server-side constraints for new cards.

collection_id.description: Local Metabase collection id to place the card in.

database_id.description: Local Metabase database id the card is associated with.

dataset_query_json.description: Metabase dataset_query JSON defining the question.

display.description: Card display type (e.g., table, bar, line).

visualization_settings_json.description: Visualization settings JSON for the card.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_card(name, database_id, dataset_query_json, display, description=None, collection_id=None, visualization_settings_json=None, archived=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0534000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0534000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    req_file = "request_logs.json"
    reqs = _load(req_file)

    def _log(status_code, credential_id=None, details=None):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + hashlib.sha256((now + "|" + str(len(reqs) + 1)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22].upper(),
            "endpoint": "create_card",
            "credential_id": credential_id,
            "status": status_code,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": now
        }
        if details is not None:
            row["details"] = details
        reqs.append(row)
        _save(req_file, reqs)

    def _enforce_limits():
        limits = _load("rate_limits.json")
        if not isinstance(limits, list):
            return None
        for lim in limits:
            if not isinstance(lim, dict):
                continue
            if lim.get("enabled") is False:
                continue
            scope = lim.get("scope", "global")
            if scope not in ("global", "all"):
                continue
            rpm = lim.get("requests_per_minute")
            if isinstance(rpm, int) and rpm > 0:
                cutoff = (datetime.datetime.utcnow() - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
                recent = [r for r in reqs if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("timestamp", "") >= cutoff]
                if len(recent) >= rpm:
                    return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded.")
            qpd = lim.get("requests_per_day")
            if isinstance(qpd, int) and qpd > 0:
                day = datetime.datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat()
                today = [r for r in reqs if isinstance(r, dict) and str(r.get("timestamp", "")).startswith(day)]
                if len(today) >= qpd:
                    return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily quota exceeded.")
        return None

    lim_err = _enforce_limits()
    if lim_err:
        _log(lim_err["error"]["code"])
        return lim_err

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(name, str) or name.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name must be a non-empty string.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if description is not None and not isinstance(description, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "description must be a string.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if not isinstance(database_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mbdb_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", database_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed database_id.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if collection_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(collection_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mbc_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", collection_id):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed collection_id.")
            _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return e
    if not isinstance(dataset_query_json, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "dataset_query_json must be an object.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if not isinstance(display, str) or display.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "display must be a non-empty string.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if visualization_settings_json is not None and not isinstance(visualization_settings_json, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "visualization_settings_json must be an object.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e
    if archived is None:
        archived = False
    if not isinstance(archived, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "archived must be boolean.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    # Supported display types (basic sanity list; accept common Metabase viz types)
    supported = {
        "table", "scalar", "bar", "line", "area", "pie", "map",
        "pivot", "scatter", "combo", "row", "funnel"
    }
    if display.lower() not in supported:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported display type.", supported=sorted(supported))
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    dbs = _load("metabase_databases_schema.json")
    db = next((d for d in dbs if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("id") == database_id), None)
    if not db or db.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Database not found or not active.")
        _log("NOT_FOUND")
        return e
    metabase_database_id = db.get("metabase_database_id")
    if not isinstance(metabase_database_id, int):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Database mirror missing metabase_database_id.")
        _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return e

    collections = _load("metabase_collections.json")
    metabase_collection_id = None
    if collection_id is not None:
        col = next((c for c in collections if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == collection_id), None)
        if not col or col.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Collection not found.")
            _log("NOT_FOUND")
            return e
        metabase_collection_id = col.get("metabase_collection_id")
        if not isinstance(metabase_collection_id, int):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Collection mirror missing metabase_collection_id.")
            _log("VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return e

    cards_file = "metabase_cards.json"
    cards = _load(cards_file)

    # Generate unique metabase_card_id (as if from Metabase response)
    used_mb_ids = {c.get("metabase_card_id") for c in cards if isinstance(c, dict)}
    next_mb_id = 1
    for v in used_mb_ids:
        if isinstance(v, int) and v >= next_mb_id:
            next_mb_id = v + 1
    metabase_card_id = next_mb_id

    # Generate local id
    local_id = "mbq_" + hashlib.sha256(f"{now}|{metabase_card_id}|{name}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22].upper()

    # Enforce uniqueness on metabase_card_id
    if any(isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("metabase_card_id") == metabase_card_id for c in cards):
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "metabase_card_id must be unique.")
        _log("CONFLICT")
        return e

    status = "archived" if archived else "active"

    row = {
        "id": local_id,
        "metabase_card_id": metabase_card_id,
        "name": name,
        "description": description,
        "collection_id": collection_id,
        "metabase_collection_id": metabase_collection_id,
        "database_id": database_id,
        "metabase_database_id": metabase_database_id,
        "dataset_query_json": dataset_query_json,
        "display": display,
        "visualization_settings_json": visualization_settings_json,
        "archived": archived,
        "status": status,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }

    cards.append(row)
    _save(cards_file, cards)
    _log("OK")
    return {"card": row}

tool_schemas.name: update_card_visualization
tool_schemas.description: Updates a card’s visualization settings (and optionally its display type) and returns the updated card record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is malformed, `visualization_settings_json` is invalid, or the requested `display` is unsupported/incompatible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to edit the card. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist in the local representation, and CONFLICT if the card is not editable due to its current state (for example archived/deleted).

card_id.description: Local Metabase card id to update.

visualization_settings_json.description: New visualization settings JSON to apply to the card.

display.description: Optional new display type for the card.

tool_schemas.name: add_card_to_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Adds an existing card to an existing dashboard with optional layout (row/col/size) and per-dashcard parameter/visualization overrides, returning the created dashboard-card link record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, negative/invalid grid values, or invalid override JSON, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot edit the dashboard or read the card. Raises NOT_FOUND if the dashboard or card does not exist in the local representation, and CONFLICT if the card cannot be placed on the dashboard in its current state (for example removed/deleted) or if the link already exists and duplicate placement is not allowed.

dashboard_id.description: Integration Server dashboard id to add the card to.

card_id.description: Integration Server card/question id to add to the dashboard.

row.description: Grid row position for the card on the dashboard.

col.description: Grid column position for the card on the dashboard.

size_x.description: Grid width (in dashboard units) for the card.

size_y.description: Grid height (in dashboard units) for the card.

parameter_mappings_json.description: Dashboard parameter mappings for the card (stored as JSON).

tool_schemas.name: create_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new dashboard in the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation, optionally assigning it to a collection and setting dashboard parameters and archived state, and returns the created dashboard record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, `collection_id` is malformed, or `parameters_json` is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to create dashboards or to write into the specified collection. Raises NOT_FOUND if `collection_id` is provided but does not exist in the local representation, and CONFLICT if the requested initial state is not allowed (for example creating directly as deleted).

collection_id.description: Integration Server collection id to place the dashboard in.

archived.description: Whether the dashboard should be created as archived.

tool_schemas.name: list_collections
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of collections from the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and/or a specific Metabase parent collection id and sorted by the requested field and order. Results are limited by `limit` (default server behavior if omitted) and you can pass the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort/pagination values, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to browse collections, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

parent_metabase_collection_id.description: Filter to collections whose Metabase parent collection id matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new collection in the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation with the provided name and optional description, parent Metabase collection id, color, and authority level, returning the created collection record. The request is rejected if required fields are missing or invalid. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid input, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to create collections, CONFLICT if the requested parent Metabase collection id cannot be used for nesting, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

parent_metabase_collection_id.description: Metabase parent collection id to nest this collection under.

authority_level.description: Metabase authority level for the collection (if applicable).

tool_schemas.name: list_tables
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of tables for a single database, identified either by `database_id` (Integration Server schema id) or `metabase_database_id` (Metabase id). Results are limited by `limit` and you can pass the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither (or both) database identifiers are provided or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the specified database does not exist in the local representation, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to browse database metadata, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

database_id.description: Integration Server database schema id whose tables should be listed.

metabase_database_id.description: Metabase database id whose tables should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_table_fields
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of fields/columns for `table_name` within a single database identified by `database_id` or `metabase_database_id`. Results are limited by `limit` and you can pass the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `table_name` is missing/invalid or if the database identifier is missing/ambiguous, NOT_FOUND if the database or table is not present in the local representation, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to browse schema metadata, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

database_id.description: Integration Server database schema id that contains the table.

metabase_database_id.description: Metabase database id that contains the table.

table_name.description: Name of the table to fetch fields/columns for.

limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing dashboard’s mutable properties (name, description, collection, parameters definition, and lifecycle state) and returns the updated dashboard record. The service validates field types, enforces allowed `status` values, and refuses invalid lifecycle transitions (for example, updating a deleted dashboard). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed input, NOT_FOUND if `dashboard_id` does not exist, CONFLICT if the dashboard cannot be moved to the requested collection or the requested state change is not allowed, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to modify the dashboard, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

dashboard_id.description: Integration Server dashboard id to update.

collection_id.description: New Integration Server collection id to move the dashboard into.

parameters_json.description: Updated dashboard parameters definition (stored as JSON).

archived.description: Whether the dashboard should be archived.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set for the dashboard.

tool_schemas.name: delete_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified dashboard from the Integration Server’s local Metabase representation and returns the resulting dashboard record (or deletion confirmation) reflecting its deleted lifecycle state. The operation is idempotent only for dashboards that are not already deleted, and it refuses deletion when the dashboard is in a state that cannot transition to deleted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid `dashboard_id`, NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist, CONFLICT if the dashboard cannot be deleted due to its current state, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to delete dashboards, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate limits.

dashboard_id.description: Integration Server dashboard id to delete.
